nodes.description: Owned.owner: address of the current contract owner, set from msg.sender in constructor and read by the onlyOwner modifier.
Owned.newOwner: pending owner address used by the two-step ownership transfer flow.
FitShibaInu.symbol: public token symbol string.
FitShibaInu.name: public token name string.
FitShibaInu.decimals: public token decimals value.
FitShibaInu._totalSupply: total minted supply, set once in the constructor.
FitShibaInu.balances: mapping of holder address to token balance.
FitShibaInu.allowed: nested mapping of owner to spender to remaining allowance.
SafeMath.safeAdd: pure addition helper with a post-condition overflow check.
SafeMath.safeSub: pure subtraction helper with a pre-condition underflow check.
SafeMath.safeMul: pure multiplication helper with a division-based overflow check.
SafeMath.safeDiv: pure division helper requiring a non-zero divisor.
Owned(): constructor that assigns the deployer (msg.sender) as owner.
Owned.transferOwnership: onlyOwner function staging a new owner address.
Owned.acceptOwnership: pending owner finalizes ownership transfer.
FitShibaInu(): constructor initializing metadata, supply and deployer balance.
FitShibaInu.totalSupply: constant view returning supply minus the zero-address (burned) balance.
FitShibaInu.balanceOf: constant view returning the balance of a token owner.
FitShibaInu.transfer: moves tokens from msg.sender to a recipient using safeSub/safeAdd.
FitShibaInu.approve: sets a spender allowance for msg.sender.
FitShibaInu.transferFrom: spends an allowance and moves tokens between accounts.
FitShibaInu.allowance: constant view returning the remaining allowance.
FitShibaInu.approveAndCall: sets an allowance then executes an external receiveApproval callback on the spender.
FitShibaInu fallback function: payable and unconditionally reverts to reject ETH.
FitShibaInu.transferAnyERC20Token: onlyOwner rescue that calls transfer on an arbitrary token contract.
msg.sender: caller-controlled address used for authorization checks, allowances and balance ownership.
safeAdd addition guarded by require(c >= a): arithmetic overflow guard used by transfer/transferFrom.
safeSub subtraction guarded by require(b <= a): arithmetic underflow guard used by transfer/transferFrom.
safeMul multiplication guarded by require(a == 0 || c / a == b): arithmetic overflow guard.
safeDiv division guarded by require(b > 0): arithmetic division-by-zero guard.
External call ApproveAndCallFallBack(spender).receiveApproval(...) executed inside approveAndCall, enabling reentrancy.
External call ERC20Interface(tokenAddress).transfer(owner, tokens) on an attacker-supplied token contract.

edges.reason: Owned constructor assigns owner = msg.sender, making the caller the privileged owner.
onlyOwner modifier compares msg.sender against stored owner before executing transferOwnership.
acceptOwnership requires msg.sender == newOwner before granting ownership.
transferAnyERC20Token is gated by onlyOwner, which checks msg.sender.
transfer debits balances[msg.sender] and emits msg.sender as the sender.
approve writes allowed[msg.sender][spender].
transferFrom spends allowed[from][msg.sender], using the caller as the spender.
approveAndCall stores an allowance for msg.sender then forwards msg.sender into the external callback.
Owned constructor writes the owner state variable.
transferOwnership stages the pending owner in newOwner.
acceptOwnership promotes newOwner into owner.
acceptOwnership resets newOwner to address(0) after promotion.
FitShibaInu constructor writes the symbol state variable.
FitShibaInu constructor writes the name state variable.
FitShibaInu constructor writes the decimals state variable.
FitShibaInu constructor mints the fixed _totalSupply.
FitShibaInu constructor assigns the entire supply to the deployer address in balances.
totalSupply reads _totalSupply.
totalSupply subtracts balances[address(0)] from _totalSupply without a guarded subtraction.
balanceOf reads the balances mapping by tokenOwner.
transfer applies safeSub to balances[msg.sender].
transfer applies safeAdd to balances[to].
transfer writes updated balances for sender and recipient.
approve writes the allowed allowance mapping.
transferFrom applies safeSub to balances[from] and allowed[from][msg.sender].
transferFrom applies safeAdd to balances[to].
transferFrom writes updated balances.
transferFrom decrements the allowance in the allowed mapping.
allowance reads allowed[tokenOwner][spender].
approveAndCall writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] before the callback.
approveAndCall reaches the external receiveApproval invocation with user-controlled spender and data.
transferAnyERC20Token reaches an external transfer call on a user-supplied token address.
The receiveApproval callback executes in the spender contract and may re-enter the token functions before approveAndCall returns.
The external ERC20 transfer callback executes in an attacker-controlled contract and may re-enter the owner-privileged path.
safeAdd result is stored into the balances mapping.
safeSub result is stored into the balances mapping.
safeAdd performs the guarded addition that the unsafe operation node models.
safeSub performs the guarded subtraction that the unsafe operation node models.
safeMul performs the guarded multiplication that the unsafe operation node models.
safeDiv performs the guarded division that the unsafe operation node models.
The payable fallback immediately reverts, blocking any ETH-driven external interaction path.

Parameter b is only meaningful inside SafeMath.safeAdd and should be folded into that function node.
Parameter a is local to SafeMath.safeSub and carries no standalone semantic value.
Parameter b is local to SafeMath.safeSub and carries no standalone semantic value.
Parameter a is local to SafeMath.safeMul and should be merged into it.
Parameter b is local to SafeMath.safeMul and should be merged into it.
Parameter a is local to SafeMath.safeDiv and should be merged into it.
Parameter b is local to SafeMath.safeDiv and should be merged into it.
The recipient address only exists as an argument of transfer and is folded into that function.
The transfer amount is only meaningful within transfer and flows through safeSub/safeAdd there.
The spender argument is consumed solely by the approve allowance write.
The allowance amount is consumed solely by the approve allowance write.
The from account is used only as a key into balances/allowed inside transferFrom.
The to account is used only as a credit key inside transferFrom.
The amount is used only by the safeSub/safeAdd arithmetic inside transferFrom.
The token owner key is only used to read the allowed mapping inside allowance.
The spender key is only used to read the allowed mapping inside allowance.
The spender is both the allowance key and the callback target inside approveAndCall.
The tokens amount is written into the allowance inside approveAndCall.
The data blob is forwarded unmodified into the external receiveApproval call, so it belongs to that unsafe operation.
The tokenOwner key is only used to read the balances mapping inside balanceOf.
The pending owner address is only stored by transferOwnership and should be folded into it.
The token address is the target of the external transfer call and belongs to that unsafe operation node.
The rescue amount is only forwarded by transferAnyERC20Token and should be merged into that function.
